The purpose of these transitions is to contextualize and compare the ancient descriptions of planetary orbits with modern scientific findings.

Then the video transitions to aerial views of the Nazca Lines. The video concludes with an ancient stone carving featuring figures with beards and hats surrounding a tree, with a winged emblem above it. The aerial view of the Nazca Lines is superimposed over the stone carving. The video speculates on what could have made the uniform holes and proposes the possibility that the holes could be prospecting holes for gold and that the Annunaki mined the gold. The video invites viewers to share their thoughts in the comments.
